We engineer next-generation intelligent robotics and AI-driven software to transform warehouse sortation and fulfillment. Our systems ensure unprecedented vertical efficiency and scalable throughput for every growing business worldwide.

The global e-commerce boom created a painful bottleneck: warehouses simply couldn't scale or sort fast enough without enormous space and labor costs. Founded on the belief that AI and robotics could eliminate this universal constraint, Unbox Robotics engineered a compact, high-precision swarm system to make rapid, vertical fulfillment accessible.

Founded in 2019, Unbox Robotics builds automation systems tailored to real-world warehouse challenges. Designed and manufactured in India, our compact, modular platform combines proprietary hardware and software for fast deployment and effortless scale.
If that kind of proximity to impact matters to you, keep reading.
Unbox Robotics is a direct place. Feedback travels fast. There are no long chains of approval before a decision gets made. If you have a point, make it, regardless of your title or tenure.

The team spans robotics hardware, AI and software, product, customer success, and business development. These functions sit close to each other by design. An engineer here has context on the customer problem their code is solving. A customer success person understands the fleet intelligence running the system they support. That overlap is intentional, and it keeps the work honest.
Benchmarked to market across engineering, product, and business roles.
Experience across robotics, AI, supply chain, automotive R&D, and enterprise software. Based in Pune, with reach across India, Europe, and Asia.
We are looking for people who are precise, curious, and motivated by work with real consequences.
All Unbox Robotics job offers follow a formal interview process through this page or a verified recruiting partner. We will never ask candidates for payment.

As logistics networks become faster, denser, and more interconnected, parcel sortation has evolved from a backend operation into a strategic capability. UnboxSort enables modern fulfillment centers, sort hubs, and delivery networks to operate with speed, precision, and flexibility at scale.

Modern fulfillment centers process thousands of parallel orders across diverse SKUs and channels. UnboxSort enables seamless order consolidation by dynamically sorting parcels into live order destinations within a compact vertical layout.
Scalable operations without increasing floor footprint

Click & Collect and store pickup models require fast, store-wise consolidation without disrupting core fulfillment operations. UnboxSort enables precise store- and order-level sortation, supporting efficient preparation for pickup and handover.
Faster preparation for in-store pickup
Stable throughput across varying load profiles
Returns handling is now an integral part of modern fulfillment. UnboxSort enables structured, rule-based sortation of return parcels, supporting faster downstream processing and inventory flow.
Improved visibility across reverse logistics flows

Retail and wholesale networks rely on predictable, store-wise order fulfillment. UnboxSort supports structured B2B workflows by consolidating parcels and cartons by store, route, or delivery schedule.
Improved delivery workforce productivity

First mile dispatch determines how cleanly parcels move through the wider delivery network. UnboxSort sorts outbound parcels by carrier, route, and destination hub at the point of handover, building dispatch-ready consignments within a compact vertical footprint.

Founded in 2019 by Pramod Ghadge and Shahid Memon, Unbox Robotics aims at enabling organisations to triumph over global supply chain challenges by revolutionising intralogistics operations via one-of-its-kind vertical robotic parcel sortation and consolidation, powered by Swarm Intelligence.

Unbox Robotics’ USP lies in its ability to scan, sort, and dispatch packages in less than 50-70% physical space through its innovative and compact vertical sorting robotic solution. It helps customers ramp up productivity by more than 3X — thereby enhancing end-customer experience.
Unbox Robotics is the worlds first 3D Robotic Parcel Sortation tech provider
